{{Quote|Jennir! Where's General Rootrock?''"<br />"''Dead.''"<br />"''Commander Limbfree?''"<br />"''Dead.|Bomo Greenbark learns of Limbfree's death from Dass Jennir|<ref name="DT:PTN" />}}
'''Limbfree''' was an individual who,<ref name="DT:PTN" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Rank">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]] states Limbfree was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and that the comic issue takes place approximately 19 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, Limbree must have held the rank by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. The resistance sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and, later once the war was over, their successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With the main Separatist forces gone, the Imperial forces continued fighting the Nosaurians, who were now considered a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]], as part of the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]]. It was during this fighting that Limbfree was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After he had finished evacuating young and [[Gender/Legends|female]] Nosaurians, the Nosaurian [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Bomo Greenbark]] asked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] as to Limbfree's location, but was informed of the commander's demise.<ref name="DT:PTN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Limbfree was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' within the [[Dark Times 1|first]] issue of the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere|''The Path to Nowhere'']] arc, which was written by Mick Harrison,<ref name="DT:PTN" /> a pen name of [[Randy Stradley]],<ref name="Insider 127">{{InsiderCite|127|Blaster}}</ref> and released in [[November 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54075/star_wars_dark_times_2006_1|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #1}}</ref>
